verdict.rationale: Certification and durability are fair questions for a hardware security key, so the axis applies. The pack, however, never mentions FIPS 140 validation, Common Criteria certification, or water/crush resistance. The only related item is a firmware integrity chip, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, certified models exist for regulated environments — FIPS 140 validated or Common Criteria certified — with documented durability (water/crush resistance)
